notes.title: NO COMMANDERS
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a1c5ba7e60c249109fd81bd4dcf0199799c9b31d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a1c5ba7e60c249109fd81bd4dcf0199799c9b31d.jpg[/img][/url]

We’re glad to be back! It’s been a while, so we’d love to remind you of some of the mechanics you can expect to come across in The Way’s full release version.


[h2][b]NO COMMANDERS[/b][/h2]

Before you can challenge the tournament’s champion, you’ll have to get through Adjutant Mirina. Her battle is a little bit different than you’re used to; this battle doesn’t feature Commanders on either side. To win, you need to eliminate all ten of the enemy’s units before they eliminate yours! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2da658e833dc6491ab0af7c980a875046f5ce3d5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2da658e833dc6491ab0af7c980a875046f5ce3d5.png[/img][/url]

Additionally, there’s a border in the center of the battlefield. This border cannot be crossed by either party. Your units will meet in the middle, and that’s where the battle will be decided.

Adjutant Mirina’s deck consists of a combination of strong melee characters and stellar support units. She’ll attempt to make a sturdy front line to keep your units busy, while keeping her support safe from harm’s way. To come out victorious, you can try to break through their front line with sheer power, or try to snipe out her support units to weaken their melee units. If you want full points and the bonus card for this fight, you’ll need to do this with six units or less.


[h2][b]AN EXTRA CHALLENGE[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/943891e14a090fd380bc6d8c258c60c0a09a5154.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/943891e14a090fd380bc6d8c258c60c0a09a5154.png[/img][/url]

If the normal battle wasn’t enough for you, you can choose to challenge Adjutant Mirina again on a higher difficulty. This won’t go unrewarded either, as there’s a special support card up for grabs!

At the start of the battle, you’ll immediately notice some big changes. First off, there’s a Guardian on the enemy’s side of the field, equipped with a Veteran’s Ring. He’s supported by a Monk, ready to utilize his healing powers.  

Secondly, walls have been placed on the far reaches of the border. This will help bolster the enemy’s defenses, as it’ll be easier for Adjutant Mirina to make a full front line. However, I do wonder if you’ll somehow be able to turn this disadvantage in your favor?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/683cf47de7f731818d4e1a176584e98b12d80121.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/683cf47de7f731818d4e1a176584e98b12d80121.gif[/img][/url]

Finally, you can only use three units to clear this battle. Your choice of combatants will decide your fate; will you come out victorious?

notes.title: Status Update & Demo Feedback
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/53e89ec30d16ee3d8a44c214916d6f0a44e0fb29.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/53e89ec30d16ee3d8a44c214916d6f0a44e0fb29.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello, friends.

We’ve been very, very busy working on The Way. We know there hasn’t been any news about the game for quite a while, but we’re about to change that. You’ll hear from us a lot more from now on, both here on Steam and on our other social media channels. Additionally, you’ll soon be able to play a new demo. Your feedback will be invaluable in finalizing the game for release!

We didn’t forget about our promise though! We still want to go over the finalized results of the last demo and the changes we made accordingly. So, without further ado, let’s dive right into it.


[h2][b]Overall[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/479b08f10f38b90eb6ab909551249b6cfebd55ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/479b08f10f38b90eb6ab909551249b6cfebd55ad.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/83ae6bf2f017b0bebd22496e7ba719e2408b8e36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/83ae6bf2f017b0bebd22496e7ba719e2408b8e36.png[/img][/url]

Overall, we’re very happy with the feedback the demo got, especially considering the issues that were introduced in this demo. For starters, all new players were locked to story mode due to a bug. As this difficulty level was designed for people who are only interested in the story, it made the fights very easy and quick to complete. There was no real need for tactical gameplay, and a lot of people reported this issue in the feedback form. It should be fixed for the next demo!

Additionally, in an earlier demo of The Way, many felt we were too generous with the amount of gameplay it offered. Players could comfortably spend fourteen hours in the demo, which is a considerable portion of the game. We decided to shorten the demo based on this feedback, but missed the mark again. People reported they were speeding through the demo in a matter of hours, especially given the fact that the game was stuck in story mode for many. We made some more changes, so let us know whether or not this feels right with the upcoming new version.


[h2][b]Tutorial[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/977df153602d28eecf0cdbbea363b09bacbfdf5c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/977df153602d28eecf0cdbbea363b09bacbfdf5c.png[/img][/url]

As this game has quite a unique battle system, the tutorial is an important portion of the game to get right. We need to find a balance between explaining all the systems the player can interact with and the time it takes to get into the actual game. Some of the feedback indicated that the tutorial dragged on too much, so we decided to divide the tutorial into multiple stages. This will gradually introduce the player to new mechanics as they appear. The dialogue has also been shortened to get you into the fight quicker. We’re looking forward to seeing how all of you like the new tutorial!


[h2][b]Story[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7ce84307f8dcd56e27857e0e00e1cca7e9bdbc38.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7ce84307f8dcd56e27857e0e00e1cca7e9bdbc38.png[/img][/url]

The story of The Way was generally received positively, but reception is noticeably weaker than the overall feedback. Players feel the story of The Way isn’t up to par with Redemption. This is something we understand, but we’d also like to reiterate that The Way is intended to be a very different experience than Redemption. While the story took center stage in the latter, The Way is a lot more focused on gameplay and features a simple story to carry the player forwards. However, thanks to your feedback, we considerably changed the story’s design: we added more dialogue and branching paths based on your interactions with the characters you’ll meet on your journey. This will make the game a lot less linear and more tailored to who you are or want to be as a person.

Currently, each tournament in the game has its own story and several endings depending on how well you perform on the battlefield. The Way features many different endings; it’s about five times bigger than Redemption. Now, you won’t get to experience all this in the upcoming demo. The Way is still a gameplay-focused experience, and most of the early dialogue will focus on explaining the rules and gameplay mechanics. We did move some dialogue and story you’d previously experience later on in the game forward to make the demo more interesting. This way you’ll get a taste of things to come, but you’ll only truly get to know the setting and its people later on in the story.


[h2][b]Dialogue[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a453e33d0ee1514044aee14dbc2e3f2ed242373d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a453e33d0ee1514044aee14dbc2e3f2ed242373d.png[/img][/url]

Regrettably, what we can do with the dialogue is limited by the simple yet inconvenient program we decided to use. This program was ideal for what we originally intended to do, but with the changes we made and the many branching paths we added, the limitations became very apparent. It’s simply not suited for the more complicated and extensive dialogue we’ve added since the last demo.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3f1610ebd3ac10eaadfa5def1c200e9fc1a13c48.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3f1610ebd3ac10eaadfa5def1c200e9fc1a13c48.png[/img][/url]

Nevertheless, we heard your feedback loud and clear and are committed to make the story the best it can be. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/97a97de51cdfe970733373cddfa3529459883864.png[/img]

Hello, folks!

Steam Next Fest has come to an end, and we’d like to thank you for your engagement and useful feedback left in a questionnaire at the end of the demo. We have yet to read and analyse every reply, and we’ll make a more detailed report about it later, but today we want to share the first results—your marks of our work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a90a4474f4bb86100a15dee437dd44bf38c477a7.png[/img]

As you can see, most players liked The Way. At the moment the average rating of the game is 4.44 points out of 5. It’s almost 89% of positive marks. For us it’s a very strong indicator that the huge work we made over the game wasn’t for nothing.

At the same time we have to say that the demo has a big and unpleasant bug that considerably influenced the game experience. The thing is that if there are no earlier saves, the game doesn’t offer the player to choose the level of difficulty—and a new game starts by default in the easiest Story Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1f0da24c98cbd000dd11765a3cf2ce03824fd92b.png[/img]

A lot of players marked this fact and reported that the fights are too easy and in some cases don’t demand any planning. It happened because in the Story Mode many fights don’t work like they should—it was created for those who doesn’t want to deal with strategic challenges.

We will make sure to fix this for the next demo so that you could assess the fights in the Classic and Hard modes. And for now we prolong the access to the demo for one more week, and you have an opportunity to try the game for yourselves (yes, in the Story Mode) and give us your feedback. We’ll surely read it.

If you want to become a tester of Ash of Gods: The Way and to be one of the first players who will see the fights of the new championships, join [url=https://discord.com/invite/ashofgods]our Discord channel[/url] and—the main thing—add our game to the wishlist!

notes.title: CATS & MEMES. NO, REALLY.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4I8ogvP.gif[/img]

Hello, friends! 

As you know, we are preparing a new demo for Steam Next Fest, and you can already play it on Monday. Apart from balance corrections, we have removed the restriction of 30 FPS, and that made our game way more smooth and pleasing to the eye. We've also [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/691690/announcements/detail/5831609977309551004]considerably changed battlefields and made them more vivid[/url][/b], placing a lot of new animated objects—they look way more classy than Redemption’s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1f0da24c98cbd000dd11765a3cf2ce03824fd92b.png[/img]

We have also added [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/691690/announcements/detail/3106919419809619945]a new redesigned intro[/url][/b] (it's not a final version though), the choice of difficulty level, [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/691690/announcements/detail/3186871789972207846]free cards animation[/url][/b], an improved screen of card replacement before the start of a fight and a lot more. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/On439ao.jpg[/img]

What we haven't added but we will for sure: we'll add a new screen for the main menu—it still demands some work with animations and music. We also plan to partially rewrite dialogues to make the story of the first tournament more complete and interesting. And of course, we'll bring back voice acting when all the texts are ready. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/97a97de51cdfe970733373cddfa3529459883864.png[/img]

And for now [b][url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]follow us in Discord[/url][/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/]add the game to the wishlist[/url][/b] and check for updates—we'll inform you as soon as the demo will be available. 

[h1]CATS & MEMES[/h1]

Working on a demo is a hard and tiring process, but we always work as a team, and that's why we chat a lot and try to cheer each other up—sometimes with absolute nonsense. And today we want to share some with you. 

For example, we couldn’t go past the telling expression of Finn’s face in one of the new cinematics. Originally this meme was in Russian, but we managed to find an English alternative—[b][url=https://youtu.be/jrkw1UgX3q0?t=47]a phrase of Daniel Day-Lewis from the ”Gangs of New York” movie[/url][/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/52aa0267e46eb4697b27675faa2d86e6b17aeee7.jpg[/img]

Sometimes, after a hard working day our artists join the Dark Side of the Force. I blame Disney and the new trilogy for all of this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2d81aa13b11ea4b6d980321d6808be40d91deab2.jpg[/img]

Here, the artist who works with battlefields took the condition “In this battle your opponent will get an unexpected reinforcement” a bit too literally… 
  
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TPnPzPR.gif[/img]

And our art-director, while testing animations, turned a poor guardian into a dirty swine, putting flies on him, because “there were no corpses nearby”.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/01140771ba6049914be6c35ef17a975da9d8c358.gif[/img]

Also he says that he’s added a scroll to a Frisian version of Kleta to punish Finn for bad fights in the tournament.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/6e3736590134bf601a6fc05309bce04c578ea93b.jpg[/img]

And he claims that he didn’t try to draw a young revolutionnaire—just wanted to attach the girl to the mother. Of course, we don’t believe him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/69d6312bfe86b00e1484325e9fc9da4aa5225b72.jpg[/img]

But sometimes the game creates memes itself. For example, a ghost of a Hammerer appeared in the deck of Berkana’s champion. Spooky! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QqS6SYA.gif[/img]

By the way, our team is quite young. But some of us are old enough to remember a very ancient meme about Techno Viking… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e47f0f3410f839002098394164ed1b160014a3a8.jpg[/img]

Anyway, we all are millennials, so the memes are usually pretty classic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/393aa8a1f97e9d44fb1c9d34acdfc93f64334001.png[/img]

And not always funny (but quite honest!)...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c0d3581e63c0f7ad89c15b86ea549f6be7c58ddd.jpg[/img]

We also share photos of our favourite pets with each other. And it seems, all of us are crazy cat lovers (the image is clickable, by the way).

[url=https://i.imgur.com/cMSe74W.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/50dea75c19802fcd3182b23a29fae6aee8be3b19.jpg[/img][/url]

It’s quite weird, but none of us has a dog. We would gladly accept them into our company though. But we have other pets too. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/hcQZu1v.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/d195fac299ebd091eba1a8a66fa90c47a8975930.jpg[/img][/url]

We hope that our pets and our stupid sense of humour have lifted your spirits. At least, just a tad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/931f0597853d76d309c066224b71f9616ef3675d.jpg[/img]

Regretfully, we won’t likely post regular updates and tell you about our game in detail anymore. We’ve always tried to create interesting quality content, but it takes a lot of time and effort—and for now these efforts don’t pay off and don’t bring enough wishlists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/70599c41c3782cc5a9908d6075d6f656ec8330ad.jpg[/img]

Nevertheless, if you like our updates and you’d like to keep reading them, it’s high time [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/]to add Ash of Gods: The Way into your wishlist and subscribe to the game to receive important updates[/url][/b].

Comments, likes and reposts of this post are also very welcome—thanks a lot for your support, anything like that is very precious for us. Besides, you can [b][url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]join our Discord channel[/url][/b]—we are always glad to talk to the players and answer any questions.

That’s all for now. We remind you that on Monday, with the start of the festival, our new demo will be available for everyone—and we are waiting for your feedback. Be sure to tell your friends about us!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AraQ8AZ.gif[/img]

And, of course, have a nice weekend!

notes.title: PREPARING FOR A NEW DEMO
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uVPNYu4.gif[/img]

Hello, friends!

Our team is intensely getting ready for the Steam Next Fest, preparing a new demo—the old one is deactivated and isn’t available anymore. Besides, we have finished the battles for all the games and will announce the search for players for a closed testing. If you want to be among the first who will see what we have made in new tournaments, [b][url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods] join our Discord channel[/url][/b], please—we will post an announcement there, when the time comes, and we’ll also collect feedback there.

And today we’ll tell you about other important updates which make our game better.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FcNWDTQ.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cinematics[/h2]

We have already shown our progress with [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/691690/announcements/detail/3106919419809619945]new cinemanics[/url][/b]. As you remember, a lot of images were black and white, and they had a lack of details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/9654b6f938359d1a662b86fe3edd0155aa793fef.gif[/img]

We’ve considerably moved forward finishing our work with separate images and making them much more colourful and rich.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UCOpqVH.jpg[/img]

Every clip sets the atmosphere of the places where Finn goes and reveals the characters he has to meet much better—and also shows emotions and relations between characters. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zyMzqoQ.jpg[/img]

Almost all the cinematics are already put together, and we’ll start adding sounds and music to them. But you will see a refreshed version of the intro in a new demo—not a final one, we’re planning to elaborate on sounds and music. 

[h2]New looks[/h2]

As you know, when in Rome, do as the Romans do. That’s why we’ve «redressed» Finn’s companions into Frisian costumes so that they wouldn’t outtand from the crowd. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3457d32d9bc40b9bcadbbd7c2437364a2d0068ea.png[/img]

They also got new poses and animations to look more alive. That’s how, for example, Raylo will move and look:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A4mf0GO.gif[/img]

[h2]New animations of battlefields[/h2]

We also go on revitalizing battlefields—adding different effects, things and animals. By the way, according to the number of locations and the variety of animations, The Way is far richer than Redemption. We’ll make one more update a bit later, and now here are some cats deciding what to do with a fresh-caught lizard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/091c2a0ca8619e2948f028e492afb2d54e937d8f.gif[/img]

[h2]Animation of cards[/h2] 

New visual effects have become one more important detail of fights. We consider it important to highlight «free» cards—the ones that don’t make you spend a turn when playing. It’ll help the player identify them faster among the usual ones.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iNUNEmf.gif[/img]

[h2]Menu[/h2]

We have also redesigned the menu: we’ve changed the concept and the colour scheme to make it more suitable for the theme of the game. But regretfully it won’t probably be in a new demo—there is plenty of work with animations ahead, to revitalise the picture and to make it more warm and cosy. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hzxggt1.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now. Be sure to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/]add the game to your wishlist[/url][/b], subscribe to the updates to follow the news and join [url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods][b]our Discord channel[/b][/url] to talk to us and share your feedback. See you!

Today we’d like to tell you about one more useful character who will follow you from tournament to tournament — the merchant. From this article you will find out what he sells and why you should visit him quite often.

notes.title: COMPANIONS: RAYLO
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

We go on talking about Finn’s companions, and today we want to meet you with Raylo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/da1a224eed65f23aa1cc9662bc460cc2bc7e3d8b.jpg[/img]

Unlike [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1293460]Kleta[/url], Raylo is cold, sarcastic and prefers to keep his distance. It seems a typical aristocratic snobbery—not to meddle with those who are unworthy of his fair company. But this young man living in the Scarlet Tower is not that simple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/87b76754bda2263628face6dba6eecc91f25d2e8.png[/img]

Being a member of a noble family, Raylo doesn't flaunt it, thinking that respect of society shouldn't be granted by birth and detesting life consisting of balls and boring receptions. That’s why he decides to make a career in Bercana’s intelligence service, where he achieves great success and not only becomes the best student but the first candidate for the mission in Frisia. Why is Eik uncontent with his candidacy?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2a986b0b9841cdfaa514d219c867db7d5bc30c0b.png[/img]

Eik is worried that Raylo is too ambitious. He thinks that it’s not wise to trust the one who put his intentions above all with the important mission. That’s why, not having other options, he addresses Finn who is not interested in fame.

It’s not easy for Raylo to accept the fact that his mission is entrusted to some untrained squirt. He thinks that Eik patronizes his foster son, and in the beginning just refuses to help, but then he follows the group to Frisia—though he is not very happy about this fact. Finn will have to put a lot of effort into earning Raylo’s respect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f3f5ae39f0f4d4a2928bdaf1222c35d66fd82f8c.png[/img]

There is one more challenge for the young aristocrate in the group—Kleta. This old and rude intelligence agent with a total lack of manners becomes one more target for Raylo, on which he can take his discontent out. The mockery of the aristocrat towards Kleta and Finn often infuriates the intelligence agent—and not only him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8c05bcd6726432ae9feeec3e61bd5190ebbf7d1a.gif[/img]

But in spite of his character Raylo can teach Finn a lot of things. It’s him who demonstrates how to use new decks, telling everything about their basics and tricks.  He is also always ready for a fight for Finn to train his skills with different decks and strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/6e283e3c4b58114d30f40d7bb29e938507e7ec11.gif[/img]

Raylo is the most difficult and controversial participant of the mission who happens to be in the group against his wish. Will the young aristocrate manage to work together with the group? Share your ideas in the comments, train at Raylo's in our demo-version and don’t forget to add the game into the wishlist!

notes.title: COMPANIONS: KLETA
notes.content:

We have already told you a lot about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/3185741930849845154]an upcoming tournament in Rigga[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/5160571092897896955]the deck they use[/url], and today we’d like to meet you with Finn’s companions—Kleta and Raylo. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1b967eb17fc571098b8395789f09e332d7fd339a.jpg[/img]

It’s hard to imagine two people who are less alike. Raylo is a young and ambitious nobleman, a sarcastic snob, putting himself above others. And Kleta—a man of the people, straight and quite rude, and he has no warm feelings for prudish and pompous aristocrates. How hard will it be for these two to get along? But both of them have something in common—they both are never at a loss for words.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iJqNBOb.gif[/img]

Kleta is a close friend and a comrade-in-arms of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/6035392156520883144]Eik[/url], our main character’s foster father. It’s hard to believe that this unpretentious bloke is one of the best intelligence agents of Berkana and one of those who stole «The Way». Risking his life,  he spent long years in Frisia, almost died there, and was happy to finally retire and go back to Berkana. Eik and Finn fin him in an old tavern.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YSHoYOm.gif[/img]

Kleta hoped that he’d have a peaceful life now, but he has to take a new challenge soon. First he has to teach Finn tricks of the game, and then follow him in Frisia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/ac9a8989d5e4e1351104090965ef2b19dd4eab20.png[/img]

The old intelligence agent is definitely not happy about it—but his sense of duty doesn’t let him refuse. No matter how crazy Eik’s plan seems to him, he’s not the one who will hole up putting all responsibility on the shoulders of an inexperienced boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3ef1379a487e713ca47708b509db1df786680308.png[/img]

In the game Kleta is responsible for the deck management. It’s also him who gives Finn the First test after which he gives Eik’s foster son the first of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/3180111792070481664]the four commanders with special abilities[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f4d725790483b5e60b249949fa4ba544a834ef93.gif[/img]


Finn is definitely lucky to have such a companion. In spite of the fact that Kleta can push one away with his rudeness, you can hardly find a more devoted person. And the point is not only that his loyalty is always with Eik’s foster son and he’ll always support him with wise advice. He will never lie for the greater good and will speak out even the most unpleasant truth. But if things go completely wrong he will stay with his friends till the very end. And an unfavouravle outcome of their mission is definitely possible.

In the next post we’ll tell you about one more companion of Finn, Raylo. And now learn from Kleta in our demo, share your impressions in comments and be sure to add our game into your wishlist!

notes.title: THE FRISIA DECK
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

After giving the general information about Rigga tournament, we’d like to pay special attention to a Frisian deck – what it looks like, in what way it is unique and what new opportunities it opens to a player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8956b5d270ab825fd9e2bfab8a8604a147e14cf1.png[/img]

Frisians are a fraction of [b]control[/b]. And when you first see it, the characters might seem pretty intimidating – you won’t find such high number of health points either in Berkana or in Bandit decks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a989daba1ba5aadac20df994f4e9b496a71e6167.png[/img]

But when you finally breath out you can see that the attack points of the characters are quite low – so they can’t cause a lot of damage. Does it mean that there will be a long and boring fight? No way!

The goal of Frisian soldiers is to hold the enemy back as much as possible, and to take away the opposing commander is the task of the Frisian warlock. It’s impossible to resist the damage he causes, so it’s in your interests to finish the fight as soon as possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e790583756a161e98954ee825187ba19af24dec8.gif[/img]

The warlock appears in the battlefield with the first summoned Frisian fighter who has the ability «Life drain». At the start he doesn’t take much, but this ability grows as almost any Frisian appears in the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7e590e423e9675f8f98d94bf0f36e938fc268c1b.png[/img]

Now, when we’ve found out why it is profitable to drag the fight, let’s speak more closely about the opportunities of the characters. First if all, about the balance of the attack and protection.

Frisian soldiers are quite hard to kill, and one of the possibilities to make the fight longer is to block the way to your commander completely while the sorcerer drags out the enemy’s life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1d134ce00efbb62ed64892c30f8363d2e4f78072.png[/img]

It’s also a good strategy for the Frisians to stay as close to the position of start as possible. A lot of characters of this fraction make only one step at a turn. It’s quite enough so that the space near the commander would get filled with the unbreakable wall of the fighters. It’s also convenient to hide weak fighters with useful effects behind the back of slow but powerful characters. For example, quite a fragile Templar, who considerably weakens the enemy, can hide behind the Centurion and become unreachable for the opponent.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NXt3Rjm.gif[/img]

Nevertheless, in the deck there are some characters who are quite good in destroying the enemy’s fighters. For example, Frisian Crossbowmen move quite fast and cause a great deal of damage. But even their attack becomes twice lower when they shoot at the opposing commander

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f20400aeac5a75b6bb042175f3a86c11b2e0d700.png[/img]

Speaking about synergy, the Frisian deck is something average between the Berkana and Bandit Decks. All in all, the Frisians are quite powerful on their own, but some of the characters can considerably strengthen their comrades. For example, the Frisian captain improves the armor of his fraction’s fighters.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NXt3Rjm.gif[/img]

It’s much more interesting, though, to have a look at how the deck of the support synergizes. There are, for example, the cards that can increase health of a group if characters, lower the attack of the hostile fighters, boost the speed of all the characters or slow down separate ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3a88e5175e74c1beead493c5c81382503b559672.png[/img]

It’s Raylo who teaches you how to play the Frisian deck – and you can also ask him for a training fight either for this fraction or against it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/ae11080656558bf15e3094a6c44baf024ca87517.png[/img]

You’ll be able to try a Frisian deck yourselves very soon, and for now subscribe to our discord channel, get some experience playint the Berkana and the Bandit deck in our demo and add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Welcome to Rigga!
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

While we were talking about Ursus, the team was working hard on the rest of the tournaments. And today we'd like to show you Rigga and give you more information about what kind of place it is and what is waiting for you there. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JtW3jMc.gif[/img]

Rigga is situated in the place where the rocks and the desert meet. Unlike green Ursus, it's a rainless land, and people there have neither merry nor gentle personality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/255e556effaf3feeae802a802802876a6bf89a65.png[/img]

Rigga is situated in Gellia—the country which has already been a part of Frisia for some centuries. But if the majority of severe highlanders in other parts of Gellia remained true to their traditions, in stone-made Rigga built by Frisians, Gellian culture is closely intertwined with the frisian one. Assimilated Gellians began to shave and to wear Frisian clothes. Animal skins were kept as decorations—as, for example in the costume of Quinna Rosette. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z9XePIU.jpg[/img]

Quinna is a supreme commander of the army of Rigga. This is quite unusual as for Frisian as for Gellian women. Some people say that it's because both Gellian and Frisian blood flows through her veins. Others mention her extraordinary talent as a commander. And only few dare whisper about her cruelty—and there are less and less of them, because they end up in dark dungeons where Quinna herself takes their skin. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VY6yA2R.gif[/img]

The fight with Quinna takes place in the arena that resembles the Coliseum. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mSTlkKU.jpg[/img]

But to get there Finn will have to prove himself worthy in other arenas—like the one looking as sundial. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/338213eca407c06cca5503f5a78de962cc1ee9c5.png[/img]

There are many other battlefields reflecting the gloomy and dark beauty of the lands of Rigga and its inhabitants' personality. And our characters are already waiting for you in the tavern!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f20400aeac5a75b6bb042175f3a86c11b2e0d700.png[/img]

See you in the second tournament! And for now follow us on Steam, join our channel in Discord, and, most importantly, add our game to the wishlist.

notes.title: COMMANDERS
notes.content:
Hello, folks! 

Last time we were talking about how to get more tactical possibilities with the help of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/3091165066124474718]card upgrades[/url]. Today we're going to tell you about one more variant— using commanders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/beaa5252cb5129eb85034b1a80a88acf43d457ba.png[/img]

As a rule, commanders are located on the battlefield— you have to lower the enemy's health to zero to win the fight. 

You get the first commander in the beginning of the game and he doesn't have any special abilities. But playing the game you can find some other cards of commanders— buy them from the trader or get them in sidequests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/708110f5d22059dcdea6cb27dcbf97aeef3f9da3.png[/img]

The second commander— Milten— comes from Kleta. He is [b]a healer.[/b] He can restore the fighters' lives which will be a very useful skill on the battlefield. There are many battles in the game, where an opportunity to heal a character so that he could stand one more round determines the outcome of the fight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/b32a21dbf16057ca586f4bcd726ffa93f6f86f87.gif[/img]

The fight against [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/5114398415755125295]the Punisher[/url], who you have to hold back at the cost of the units' life, is exactly like this. Another example is [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/3105791707989048005]the duel[/url], where the damage comes after the fighter’s death. But use this ability reasonably— Milten heals his allies at the cost of his health and only once in three turns. Besides, he can’t restore your fighter’s lives if he has to spend all of his health points to do it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2e8c195e8023b6acd0ef826b8ef150ab71e3be1d.png[/img]

The next commander— Ainsly— prefers attack to protection, and that’s why she offers one more tactical opportunity— [b]boost of the attack[/b] for a chosen fighter.

The attack increases till the end of the round and can help to destroy a strong enemy fighter with a high number of health poins. This is also a powerful support against the Frisian deck which fighters are famous for their strong health. It’s lucky that you can buy a new commander from a trader at the beginning of the Rigga tournament. You can use this skill as well as Milten’s healing every three turns. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/6cbf7bb4a31fd4dff6395c997f3cb80852fc90bc.png[/img]

After that we get commander Deming, [b]the strategist[/b]. He becomes available during the second tournament, in one of the quests. With the help of this commander you can play one extra card every three turns during the round. It can become a good deal of help in the beginning of the fight or will help to decide a definite tactical fight in a necessary moment. The ability is active till the end of the turn and combines perfectly, for example, with a Field Equipment card. So you can get extra cards from the deck to balance them in the most effective way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/d12d857277f7fa4985df6e7af96cecfbfbfd4d32.png[/img]

The last commander who we get in Golla is Jarlet [b]the necromancer[/b]. He can resurrect any of your characters who have died in the fight earlier—but only once during the fight. Regretfully, the gear of the resurrected character will disappear, but the upgrade will stay. This action isn’t considered a move so you will still be able to summon one more character from the deck. 

You will be able to see the commanders in action very soon, and for now add our game into the wishlist and follow us!

notes.title: REDEMPTION CHARACTERS: 20 YEARS AFTER
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

We go on talking about the destiny of Redemption’s characters. Last week we told you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293460/view/6035392156520883143]about Eik’s life[/url], and today we’re going to share King Ho’s story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/42851a67a07d18f5498bfbac3b8f88bb1cc4d547.png[/img]

The future prince had been prepared to reign since childhood. But life in the palace never seemed appealing to Ho. The future throne seemed like a heavy chain on his neck, and endless bows,receptions, shallow intrigues—all that Jerana’s aristocracy lived for—gave him only feelings of hatred and repulsion. His only consolation was lessons of martial arts that the boy was taught on the demand of his father, crown prince Trig.

Training was easy for the prince, and he became proficient in fencing and shooting. But it was dagger throwing where Ho showed his real talent. Not only did he use them perfectly in melee combat, but he also threw them with such accuracy that his teachers advised Trig to continue his son’s education in a different place. 

Ho admired this idea. He was pretty tired of the special treatment he got in the palace, and he asked his father to send him to an archer’s company in Albus, in the kingdom Odala—as far as possible from Jerana where every dog knew who he was. Trig didn’t stop his headstrong son and agreed with the burgomaster of Albus about the transfer. But he insisted that young bodyguard Sop would accompany his son. At first, Ho was unhappy with his father’s decision, but he changed his opinion fast, when the young warrior became his friend. 

That’s how the young prince got to Albus. Hiding his background, he changed his name and started calling himself Hoda. But it was much harder to get rid of the manners, giving out his noble roots. Even trying to keep as friendly as he could in the company of fellow fighters, joking on himself and on the others, Hoda didn’t become a close friend to anyone—apart from Sop, of course. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f2118d46530c0bbb95cb86f5e09bc2c6ea41cbb8.jpg[/img]

However, the young prince enjoyed his life as an archer and quietness far from Jerana’s palace. But this peaceful time came to an end, when the Reaping started. 

Hoda joins the group of a resigned captain Thorn Brening and leaves Albus, devoured with disease. He heads to Ursus, where his grandfather, the king of Jerana lives at the moment. But the group gets caught in an ambush, and Hoda gets a bad injury. Blance, who turns out to be near, saves the young man, but at the same time the old king dies from a heart attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/332f3e3862b3b85ced6105d378539ec9af53c272.jpg[/img]

The throne passes to Trig, who finds out about the sad events in Albus and tries to look for his son. The father and the son meet in Opakum—but Sop, who is charmed by the reaper, murders the king.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bElmcWi.gif[/img]

Hoda is destroyed by grief. His family is dead, his only close friend is the victim of evil charms, and his duty makes him do the thing he was trying to escape so hard — to put on the crown and ascend to the throne. 

When Ho buried his father and Sop, he got down to business—confidently, harshly and cleverly. Like a monarch. The previous young guy with a disdainful and impudent smile stayed in some other life. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eNqPXi4.gif[/img]

When the war ended, Berkana was in ruins. Dozens of destroyed towns, hundreds of burnt villages, thousands of people left without home, unplanted fields were a threat of hunger and death. There were hard years ahead. 

The new king started to restore Berkana. The first thing he sacrificed was the luxury of the palace. He collected all the decorations and changed them for grain in Vandilia. He ordered to give the grain to people and that’s how he gained their sincere love. The people appreciated their unpretentious, ascetic monarch who preferred simple and convenient clothes to embroidered camisoles and royal gowns.

But there were some things which the king didn’t manage to do. As Ho concentrated on restoring the country and getting common people back to normal life, he couldn’t prepare to a new threat.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/gv5DH8R.png][img][/img][/url]

In spite the king understood perfectly that the new war with Frisia was inevitable, he still hoped to get more time. But his calculations were wrong. And now he and Berkana have to face a new challenge. Luckily, there are true people like Eik near him, who are ready to give life for the country’s well-being.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e63ffb0ae56ff2c2f40c67b7c84b6c6cb8e7401f.png[/img]

The story of king Ho goes on, and it depends on the main character of The Way Finn only how it is going to end. 

Download the demo-version, meet changed Eik and king Ho and share your impressions in comments. And also follow us and add our game to your wishlist.

notes.title: REDEMPTION CHARACTERS: 20 YEARS AFTER
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

As many of you may know, the story of The Way begins twenty years after the story of Ash of Gods: Redemption. The Great Reaping and the Last War have passed, but Frisians are planning to attack the kingdom of Berkana. 

King Ho and his true subject Eik, the veteran of the Last War, remember the horrors of the past very well, and they understand how crushing the consequences of a new war can be. That's why both of them do all their best to avoid it—each in their own way. 

What has happened to the characters for all those years? Have they changed since the time of Redemption? We're going to share their stories with you—and today we'll talk about Eik's way. 

[h2]EIK[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31161901/4e44a05c1f550fb09f79b5de18556bf91727c765.png[/img]

Finn's mentor and the foster-father started as a common soldier. Military science seemed easy to him, and being high and looking tough, Eik stood out from other recruits. He was thought to become Prince Trigg's bodyguard, but he gave Eik another honorable position—Jerana's Guard Master. As some malicious tongues say—because of fear of looking small near such a giant. 

The real cause was that Trigg trusted the warrior. He understood clearly that behind the exterior of a simple and rude soldier there is a clever, loyal, attentive and scrupulous man, who trusts nobody without a reason. So even being a Guard Master he treated his subordinates as equals which helped him to be completely aware of everything that the Prince needed to know. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31161901/9b0f5e73671f140a5082cde024ff8a273e5b21b7.jpg[/img]

When the Reaping started, Trigg sent Eik to come with Hopper Rouly in search of his son Ho— because he was one of his best and most trustworthy warriors. The situation with the Harvest got worse because of the war with Frisia, and Eik almost died in the fight near Opakum, covering newly crowned King Ho, who got the power after his father's death. 

When Eik recovers from his wounds, he refuses to become one of the generals of the Berkanan army. All of those people who he considered close friends died in the war, and the giant feels guilty because he wasn’t with them. Devastated, he follows the Frisian army alone. He finds and destroys the enemy's spies. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y03HX7I.jpg[/img]

On the border of Gellia he finds a small town wiped off the face of the earth by the enemy’s retrieving army. In this town he finds a four-year boy crying over his mother’s dead body. Eik sees the same miserable and lonely soul in the child, Eik takesthe boy with him.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NUILVqx.png[/img]

What does it mean to the old soldier—to get a son all of sudden, even if it’s a foster-son? Realizing all responsibility, Eik is returning to Berkana in hope to get the boy a better life.

The warrior becomes a great support for young king Ho, who gives him a position of Master of Surveillance. Eik understands that he has to learn a lot to provide enough help to the monarch and also give his foster-son good education. So he starts to learn himself, studying martial art, history, languages and even etiquette as thoroughly as he can. But even when Eik becomes more well-mannered and moderate, he still prefers to speak discreetly and act decisively. But now this decisiveness is strengthened by knowledge and a lot of experience.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31161901/80664f41cdefa62e2ec24f492d7e86a3b54c5681.png[/img]

And it all happened thanks to the boy who had become a new reason to live for Eik.

notes.title: OFFICIAL STATEMENT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e75944c3a066afa9d0f4df1e625564f28ac66a2a.jpg[/img]

Hello, friends.

As you know, every Friday we talk about fights in our game, but now it seems inappropriate. Today we want to speak on the situation happening in Ukraine. 

Perhaps, it should have been done last Friday. But the shock from what had happened was so great that we just went on doing the usual chores. Maybe it’s for the best—we had time to think everything over and speak consciously.

There are both Ukrainian and Russian people in our team, but we don’t divide people by their nationality or some other basis. The only thing that really matters for us is mutual respect. We always try to listen, to understand and to support each other—and we still work together as a team.

All of us have relatives, friends or fellow developers in Ukraine. We worry about everyone who is there very much. And it’s scary for us to understand that we can hardly help them. But at least we are able not to be silent.

We are young, and we know about wars only by hearsay. It’s frightening to watch the things that are happening now. But we can’t imagine how terrified are the people right in the middle of the action.

We want all of us to have future. The future where no one has to be afraid. The future where there is no place for missiles and hatred to each other. And we hope it will come as soon as possible.

AurumDust

notes.title: THE BANDIT DECK
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/dc530701ef8656272969b1e85bdd011d64d0e623.png[/img]

Hello, friends!
Today we'd like to tell you about the bandit deck, to show its strong sides and of course to share some interesting tricks that give us an advantage over the Berkana deck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/9df3a3904861ad499e17843f4e449e1b8d8fd62f.png[/img]

For the first sight Berkana’s advantage is obvious. Units look stronger, can wear more items, and the items themselves considerably increase your health and attack. But the bandit deck has some other advantages using which you can defeat a much stronger opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/cbe32262eb5265961469d3122b2fc9b34a104f35.png[/img]

The character who teaches us to use the bandit deck is Raylo — a previous but unsuccessful candidate for the mission in Frisia. What do we learn from him?

[b]First of all, bandits are experts in teamwork.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a391e9191ce6f32cf5cd0cf150fc1de10352673f.png[/img]

Surprisingly, it’s the bandit deck where you can see the fighting spirit — when a definite bandit dies, others get stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/62b50f12cbee28ec86ddbed62212cac98ad8645b.gif[/img]

[b]Secondly, what kind of bandit doesn’t use dirty tricks?[/b]

If in Berkana’s deck almost every unit is a mighty warrior,  the bandits are mostly weak characters — or at least they look like that.  But if you take a closer look you’ll see that things are not so simple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1ba660f67b5f263e735e27bf331252f6200e312f.png[/img]

Every bandit has a feature which helps to defeat even the strongest enemy — you only have to choose carefully who to fight. The slayer, for example, hides a poisonous dagger behind his back. It gives him a chance to destroy any enemy — if the slayer will manage to pierce his armour. 
By the way, usual bandits can also use poison if you cast a proper effect on them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c1d42fed69646e54277a0b6e0adb02331adae9d7.gif[/img]

[b]Thirdly, bandits can easily outnumber the enemy.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/334c05c5c86bb9add609ad852fdd3a052cd47dcb.png[/img]

There are a lot of cards in the deck that help to summon more than one unit per move. Really, what bandit will do the job alone? Besides, there are also Ambush cards in the deck. They let you add one more bandit on the battlefield in exchange for some health points of your commander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/5a498f188bb5c948ab5e320e68041b5e873cb8e6.gif[/img]

In general, if almost all fighters in the Berkana deck prefer to act on their own, when you choose the bandit deck you can get a pretty good combination of units with a bunch of dirty but effective tricks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f540cbb9a7ed11409dbd29f7c0791813aab71567.png[/img]

Bandits can fill the battlefield practically in a flash and strengthen each other greatly. Their spearman is able to strike from his companions’ backs. This deck looks like a puzzle which can be rebuilt endlessly, and you will still find more and more variants.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/d89a783419e6be5acbc083ff37bc854652a2fc13.png[/img]

Try to play with the bandit deck in the new demo, tell us about your impressions in the comments, follow us and add the game to the wishlist!

notes.title: NEW CINEMATICS: WE NEED YOUR FEEDBACK
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a4fcddf0fe184c6bbe2ccac7807b19e237af8bf2.png[/img]

Hello, friends!

Today it's Friday, and we decided to cut talking about different mechanics and fights with the news about important changes — this time in cinematics.

If you have already tried our demo, you know that the intro and the cutscenes in the game differ considerably from its visual style. And of course they lose significantly to the videos from the original project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0e78b96adb751986e74ff604a57154cb53222be7.jpg[/img]

So why did we focus on those rough sketches?

The thing is that a good video at the level of Redemption would be worth to us as a quarter of the whole game — in the form that was planned. That’s why — because of our budget restrictions — we had to focus on this variant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1cde410529d8a40f1fa21da1fb922529579cec45.png[/img]

Nevertheless, as we started changing our approach to the game and making it more difficult, we understood that the difference between the videos and the level of the project stands out more and more, and players only proved it with their feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/ea7e0ebbc7827957278a0c704bbeef5f0790e463.jpg[/img]

That’s why we decided to try and fix the situation and create new videos for the game with help of our amazing artists — and are ready to share first achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/fcf2d8f5f081190d8a0a31763351479497b9f3ff.jpg[/img]

In spite of the fact that in new cinematics there won’t be as many movements as there were in old versions, the result, however, must surpass them by far thanks to accurately structured composition, a brand new level of detailing and a thorough work with colour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f075c08954a17dbbac3816fc62f6d9cd4e5b5ac6.jpg[/img]

The characters began looking much more naturally. Distorted proportions, very rough strokes, wooden mimic — it’s all in the past. We paid a lot of attention to face expressions so that we could transfer emotions as accurately as possible. That’s how, for example, new Quinna Rosette looks at old Fill. Run, Forest, run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/21a831649b5332bde696144f1d58c2d87aded746.jpg[/img]

A great deal of work was done on the surroundings. The old videos were concentrated firstly on the characters and their actions, that’s why the cutscenes weren’t so satisfying with detailing and looked quite meagre. We tried to fix it in new cutscenes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/751cb2bb0bc4fe416a592c9049fdeb46e9451e7a.jpg[/img]

It’s a laborious job, and of course we have to spend a considerable amount of time to finish everything.  However, we’re sure that the result is worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0ebdbd7bd79db7687280222e6f2d1785799ea68e.png[/img]

In the ready videos motion effects will be used to make scenes more lively and visually interesting — but we will keep them till the next updates.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yA490nS.jpg[/img]

That was the way our cinematics have passed — from rough sketches to arts that are complicated and much more suitable for the style of the game. This happened largely thanks to your responses, and it’s vitally important for us to get some feedback from you. Please write your comments about your attitude to this upgrade, if you like what you see or not. We are very grateful for any comments and want to express our gratitude to our compassionate community. 

We wish everybody a merry Christmas and we will be sure to come back before the end of the year with a present — a new demo-version. There won’t be any new cinematics in it but we will keep you updated about our progress. So be sure to follow us and don’t forget to add our game to wishlist. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

notes.title: THE PUNISHER
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/22fcb2a4da1e45ceae063010bc29b0ec820f733d.png[/img]

Hey, guys! 

It’s time for us to tell you about a new battle, and this Friday we’re going to speak about one of adjutant Mirina’s qualifications. It’s the fight during which you will have to confront a deadly unit, and you will need to protect your commander from him. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/6e1120dad5273d09ac7f85053164c22dc0d5beb4.png[/img]

[h2]HOW DOES THE FIGHT GO?[/h2]

This time we’re not attacked by[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/3105792342253330322] a bandit horde which we were talking about in the previous post[/url] — there is only one fighter on the battlefield in the beginning of the fight. But he is worth the whole army.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/107bf27c51884e5490aef3fb7a25109a8c9464eb.png[/img]

He isn’t called the Punisher for nothing — if he gets to our commander, he’ll destroy him with  a single attack. It’s pretty hard to kill this unit, but he can be held back. So the main thing is to find the right tactics. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lEBXt9k.gif[/img]

The main goal remains the same — to destroy the enemy’s commander. But this is also not easy — he has considerably more health points than ours.  Besides, he has quite a nasty surprise — a very powerful spell. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/b22285ab8ba7311055a5a0e04dd2e7cc3f912560.png[/img]

[h2]DIFFICULTY[/h2]

We’re still testing challenger battles because they turned out to be incredibly difficult due to the large quantity of deserters in the enemy’s deck — their teamwork with the Punisher almost guarantees failure if you’re not lucky with your cards. We don’t like it. Besides, in the enemy's deck there are three stunning spells able to break any tactics. That’s why we decided to remove bandits from the battle and replace them with Berkana’s fighters. You can assess the result in our new demo. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c557edb4cc23385f31754c9d469ea7a7dd7bb124.png[/img]

A special condition for the win doesn’t allow you to use rangers — in this case the victory won’t be counted. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lXi6dYR.gif[/img]

[h2]IN SEARCH OF PERFECT BALANCE[/h2]

While we’re trying to work out the perfect balance in the challenger battles, we would like to mention difficulties we had faced during the development of its original version. 

To create the Punisher we had to make a lot of efforts and go through numerous iterations. The main aim was to create a mighty and dangerous unit who is hard to confront but is possible to block. That’s why the Punisher has plenty of health points, almost unbreakable protection and poison resistance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/50ca8242ec532717b542caa9a28a455597178da5.png[/img]

We've been experimenting with the Punisher’s strength for a long time so that the player had both enough problems with him and enough time to deal with other units allocating the resources properly. Besides, we increased the health of the hostile commander to make attack strengthening as important as the protection of the unit who holds the Punisher back. 

You can fight the punisher and his tough commander in our new demo. Until then follow the news, subscribe to our page and add the game to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

notes.title: BANDIT HORDE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/db83a8dcf9e09bfa087492fe5b46ce2062a14aeb.png[/img]

Hello, friends!

We go on introducing the mechanics of Ash Of Gods: The Way. [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293460/view/3105791707989048004]The previous post was dedicated to the mechanics of duels.[/url][/b] Now we’re going to tell you about the fight with Adjutant Dofus where you will have to confront the bunch of bandits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/4b21cccb207440ff8a94ae45f7f8616775e04423.png[/img]

[h2]HOW DOES THE FIGHT GO?[/h2]

The first thing we see starting the fight is a narrow battlefield 3x7 ot the other side of which there is a hostile commander. We have to get to him through the bunch of bandits, who had occupied most of the territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e1b20c2abc399efabe160e6f6b53e0ef6598347b.png[/img]

Our first task is to pick up fighters who can stand against the onslaught of the outlaws. You should consider that while we can only choose one fighter at a time, the army of bandits slowly comes closer and closer at full force. Yet in the qualification mode the enemy’s commander can’t summon new units — but he has a complete arsenal of dirty tricks among his cards of support.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qPvWIgw.gif[/img]

In the beginning of the fight the enemy’s team has quite low attack and health points numbers. But among the bandits there are those who die and thus strengthen the rest of the fighters. That’s why the best way is not to kill but to block these bandits, not letting them get to your commander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a925e076a9c37f9b8c5c73b6beba92c222eddcf7.gif[/img]

Like any battle, the bunch of bandits can be won through finding the right key that will help you cope easily with the seemingly unbeatable crowd. But in this fight there are a lot of opportunities to find your own solutions.

[h2]DIFFICULTY[/h2]

In more difficult challenger battles we decided to make it harder  in various areas. First, there are more fighters whose death makes others stronger — and it’s harder to hold them back. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/abbdd5f390d992103a2dd7323d95c45336ecf4dc.png[/img]

Secondly, in this fight your opponent has a deck of characters, so there are more and more enemies in the battlefield with each round which leaves less space for maneuvers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e2a658d293f803459a1d6ee7f71af929fad2fcb1.png[/img]

And finally, the main thing is the new condition of win which is having at least three of your warriors alive when the enemy’s commander dies. Assuming that you have a standard deck of ten characters, you have to be very careful — it’s not a situation where you can easily afford to lose a fighter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c6a5993db2c79814c82e5dbcd742bfffb1576bda.jpg[/img]

[h2]IN SEARCH OF PERFECT BALANCE[/h2]

It was very important for us to make this fight interesting and difficult enough for a player and not to turn it into a thoughtless deathmatch. Luckily we found a balance quite fast, varying the number of units whose death strengthens their teammates. Whereas there is only one unit in qualification mode, there are three of them in the challenger battles which turns even the weakest bandit into a dangerous and serious opponent.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d46290D.gif[/img]

A new version of this fight will be available in our new demo — press the «FOLLOW» button in Steam not to miss this news and the information about other mechanics and fights. And be sure to add us to wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

notes.title: DEMO FEEDBACK
notes.content:
Hey, folks!

As you know, we released a reworked demo version of The Way a month and a half ago, and I reckon it is time to sum everything up, to discuss your feedback, to share what we are doing with it right now and to tell you more about the game overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0b4976bc768090ebb5451f51e15820056e61c03b.jpg[/img]

First of all, I'd like to thank everyone who has played the game and shared their thoughts with us. To be frank, sometimes developers spend so much time in their games, and it is hard to recognize an issue or a flaw even if you face it every day. And that's where the community steps in, reviewing your ideas with a fresh eye and providing a clear message about what works alright and what doesn't. You are a really big part of the development process, and we are very grateful for your time and consideration. You are making our game way better than we could do that alone. Thank you so much for that.

[h3]So, what do we do with your feedback?[/h3]

Well, I believe it is worth mentioning that there was a vertical slice of The Way in the beginning of this year, a completely different game focused on gameplay with a simple generic story to follow. It was all about regular fights against different opponents with different decks. The reviews were very positive, and The Way even won 'Best PC Game' award on IndieCup but we also knew that some of you weren't that happy about the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e09e8eb1cb365707138ecb84cee0aa58b33995ea.png[/img]

We do understand that a great deal of players want us to make a sequel to the original Redemption game while we are making a completely different game of a different genre in the Ash of Gods universe. Your feedback changed that. You want us to create interesting characters, to tell stories with moral choices and dire consequences—and we decided to answer that call. We have spent a lot of time reworking the game to make it more complex and more interesting in terms of gameplay and story. And the last demo we published is the result of that hard work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3dd476cf44eff49a2bd5be6033ce575977d711d8.jpg[/img]

This extra work is a huge risk for us, to be honest—we never planned those changes, the budget of the game is very limited and we definitely need more money to complete the game. But we wanted to make something you guys will love, and if the game succeeds there's a chance we can make you happy with Ash of Gods 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/442d6bfd2ab41984af67ae5c5a147c8729d69e95.png[/img]

[h3]So, what's the difference between the vertical slice and the new demo?[/h3]

First of all, we've managed to make almost every battle unique adding new mechanics and scripts. We wanted to challenge players, constantly changing rules to create a kind of a puzzle. No more simple fights on the same battlefield with 3 lines. You should be flexible and inventive to end up victorious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/860276afeff6b93a480c5eccf6105570af8cbcdb.jpg[/img]

These battles are also justified with the main story. It is not as big and as complex as Redemption's, of course, due to obvious limitations of our budget and time and the game's genre, but we did our best to make it fun both for the fans of the original game and the new players. There are a few familiar characters in the game, some lore, references to Redemption events and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a043f35e9cc2ec9ba83700d7642934c0be420d3d.jpg[/img]

We also created a story for every tournament with moral choices and different outcomes. The first tournament is pretty simple though and mostly focused on exposition and explanation of rules and mechanics, so there are only 3 different and rather simple endings. The second one has 6 possible endings based both on the player's skill and choices, the third one has around 8 and I believe it is safe to say that the game itself has a minimum of 7 different finales at the moment but I guess the true number is somewhat like 14-ish. Of course, there are side quests—and some of them can affect the main story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a0ec16a33b264c36513ec1fffb21239a67b9686d.jpg[/img]

Another thing worth mentioning is art. In the vertical slice most of the visuals were placeholders from Redemption with a few roughly drawn characters.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/cuSnK2r.jpg][img]https://i.imgur.com/cuSnK2r.jpg[/img][/url]

We've completely reworked all characters and animated them even better than we did in Redemption (added more movements and breathing).

[previewyoutube=RWzjwf7o5eE;full][/previewyoutube]
We've also created about 60 battlefields...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1fb942cd00c7c2c987c018f97140d9a185d96b88.jpg[/img]

3 tournament backgrounds...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2cb5a47011ad2871ab8df9cf0ddb2e0d19678d78.jpg[/img]

and 4 places for camp where you can talk to NPCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8a38c87a5948d26c689d11ca58b51a3384041865.png[/img]

We wanted to create new battle characters as well but a studio and actors are required to do that, and it was impossible due to COVID-19, so we are stuck with Redemption's units. It is also a certainly costly venture which requires a lot of time, and we desperately need this time and money to rework the game.

Now, back to the demo. Of course, we didn't manage to do everything we wanted in time, there are obvious flaws like the lack of balance and some important features are missing but the goal of the release was to learn more about your experience—what you did and didn't like, is there any big issues we overlooked or some ideas which work different than we expected. That was really useful for us. We gathered enough feedback to make the game better, and now it is time to share what we are doing with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/805db1ac968d8c4f40ae4e61337e4558ee62587e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Changes we did due to your feedback[/h3]

The very first reported issue of the demo was expectedly rough UX. We were aware about the problem, and we are doing our best to make the UX curve as smooth as possible. The qualification round is expected to be pretty simple and enjoyable now but challenging enough to be interesting at this point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/90d44a71eafbd381dc037891c6996d47b6810512.png[/img]

Challenger battles are way more complex. We do not like the idea of simple hard mode fights where you are playing the same battles but against a stronger deck. The idea was to make them unique but understandable, adding additional mechanics, scripts and rules to the original fights, changing the size and the shape of battlefields to make a new challenge. Thus, the qualification round is the place where you can test your strategies and experiment as long as you want, a sneak peek of the real battles, while the challenger battles are the real test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0e8cd4363d087edacbc160bfced47d8d1083a85e.png[/img]

Since we are talking about challenger battles, another issue is attempts. The idea was to make an additional challenge for a player and also to add more tension and drama to the narrative, to make a difference between an okay-ish and truly outstanding performance which will impact the result of the tournament. I would like to thank [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/fluxit12]fluxit[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198007643928]vladimir.msg[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198020310580]volvovics[/url] for the thorough feedback on that matter. We realized that this feature is not just a limitation but also a punishment—you are feeling uncomfortable and pressured and won't get the reward if you didn't manage to win the fight for a limited number of attempts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/b3610ff884d9e2407d3108aba47cb31b0a420013.jpg[/img]

Yet, we needed this feature to determine how good a player was performing. That's why we've changed the original idea. Attempts now are actually the best result of the battle of other tournament challengers. If you beat or repeat it, you get a small bonus in gold and more glory. If you don't, you are still getting the main reward when you finally win the fight. Also, we increased the amount of attempts for every fight to make this challenge a bit more fair.

Another problem is a bit of randomness which affects the experience in some fights which could be much easier if you had the right characters to do the job. Of course, we can't completely fix that because it will totally kill the replayability and challenge of the game but we decided to allow changing one of your cards in the beginning of the fight. Also, at some fights you have a bigger starting hand compared to the standard of three cards for each deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e45d7c16cb2507a81d9d32346a989a1dc888b8aa.png[/img]

We also reworked some of the battles to make them more understandable and less random. Thus, we removed 'an unpleasant surprise' thing where you lose all your characters once you placed someone on the battlefield, and changed the mechanics of 'the duels' fight (thanks, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/alpasy]alpasy[/url]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2314f3730bbd58b0cf11bd9dea8af1a977aacdb0.jpg[/img]

We updated the descriptions of battles to give more information for a player about the fight, thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198135538727]DeadlyDan's[/url] feedback. We also added an option to discuss the fight with your mentors to get valuable advice and ability to quickly choose one of your saved decks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/23453e165c446edb0c16a074bedffbbb40bd17c2.jpg[/img]

Speaking of changes in UI, we are completely reworking deck management at the moment as well as some other important parts, and also adding new things we need like, for example, a merchant UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/983391f64531f484bb8ec88386508b55b5b664bb.jpg[/img]

There are a great deal of other changes: we added drag-n-drop mechanics to the deck manager, changed the map, added an option to remove the card's animation to play faster (thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198025465081]devxx[/url]), and reverted the scroll for zooming out the battlefield. Also, we are reworking the tutorials and changing the flow of the game to make the experience even better, to show a player some tips he can use later, reworking card upgrades to make them more interesting, reworking in-game cinematics and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/315beebe464fca604b8c1d69f82b12ed5ee0b51b.jpg[/img]

Of course, some of these things are a work in progress yet. But once we finish this, make sure we will update the demo to learn more about your experience once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a0565037be60d1335d037e0fd5f9ee4db546b9d5.png[/img]

Meanwhile, I'd like to thank you once again for being such a great community. My special thanks to the folks from Discord ([b]найк[/b], [b]Ratnik_RUS[/b], [b]KoPLLIyH[/b], [b]res7less[/b]) who provided a lot of feedback. You can also [url=discord.gg/ashofgods]join our Discord to share your opinion there or to talk to us[/url], we are always happy to do that.

Please, follow us on Steam, add the game to your wishlist—and we will do our best to make something you guys will enjoy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

Cheers,
A.

notes.title: New demo of Ash of Gods: The Way
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c89bb6b5583c1ccf28cd54b3b99cee77459376ea.png[/img]

Hey folks!

We are here to show you another version of Ash of Gods: The Way, a demo for [b]Indie Cup Celebration 2021[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8a38c87a5948d26c689d11ca58b51a3384041865.png[/img]

As you may know, we released a demo for Steam Next Festival this summer. We gathered a lot of positive reviews, even won a few awards like Best PC Game on IndieCup and Excellence in Visual Art on DevGamm Spring 2021. But we also carefully reviewed the feedback we gathered on these events as well as publishers', streamers' and players' feedback from private testing and decided to change the concept a bit to improve it. Thus, the game significantly changed since, and this demo will show you the new version of The Way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3a991c6f6dfbcaede502e42d2ad4b0a1d394d767.png[/img]
 
The new idea behind the game is [b]tactical combats with constantly changing rules for every fight[/b]. Now every encounter is a puzzle with original mechanics, scripts, battlefields of different shapes and sizes and, sometimes, very nasty and unexpected surprises. It is not a simple card battler anymore but a deep and entertaining game where you should adapt your strategy and change it on the go to end up victorious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/442d6bfd2ab41984af67ae5c5a147c8729d69e95.png[/img]

Another big change is [b]more focus on storytelling[/b]. Every tournament is not just a simple bunch of fights now but a small story with a few different outcomes depending on player's success on the battlefields and his choices in dialogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/120c6d77b6ede8501ec7aad0365582b8ccb17ee3.png[/img]

The new demo is a bit rough around the edges, it doesn't offer a flawless experience, it lacks a few important things yet and its balance is probably not perfect, but we want to share it with you to get an early feedback which is very important for us.

Please, join our Discord to tell us what you think about the demo or post your feedback to Steam forums. We are really appreciate it. Thank you.

notes.title: THAT'S THE WAY
notes.content:
Welcome to Ash of Gods: The Way store page! This is our second single-player story-driven game set in Ash of Gods universe and we hope you will enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3aa930da152b45459969af1b671b530582a7440a.png[/img]

What this game is? The Way is a turn-based tactical card game with a unique but simple gameplay. Pick up a card from the deck of characters and put your hero to any of three available lines, then strengthen him up with an item or use a spell from the support deck. To win you have to reach opponent's commander and reduce his health to zero. If your commander dies, you are defeated.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i1RDyVR.gif[/img]

There are six factions available in the game with a great deal of synergy skills and unique support items and spells. Learn more about its synergy to create an efficient and original strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2fe2fbfe438025082fdae74845b6318df2c24e90.jpg[/img]

It is important to mention that The Way is not a sequel to our previous project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/691690/Ash_of_Gods_Redemption/][b]Ash of Gods: Redemption[/b][/url], though it is the same world 20 years later and you can visit places you've visited before, hear about Redemption's events and even meet a familiar characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/cce126eb936f95423f752cc3875edf23ed2fd5a2.jpg[/img]

The game will likely to be released in the middle of the year. We are also going to make limited testing for The Way via Steam Playtest. Follow us to keep yourself updated.

Thank you for being with us,
AurumDust team.
